run_gtest_output_test: run the gtest output test to verify Google C++ Testing Framework text output matches golden file
generate_gtest_golden_file: generate a golden file by running gtest_output_test.py with the --gengolden flag
normalize_test_output: normalize Google Test program output by removing locations, stack traces, and time info
remove_locations_from_output: remove all file location info from Google Test program output using regex substitution
remove_stack_traces_from_output: remove all stack trace details from Google Test program output using regex patterns
